how many applications landed per outreach school when we match names even if written a bit differently, show every school including those with zero (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)
attempts.response:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT 
    a."Applicant",
    a."School" AS app_school_raw,
    o."School Name" AS matched_school,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) DESC) AS rn
  FROM "lpf_applications" a
  CROSS JOIN "lpf_outreach" o
  WHERE jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9
),
best_matches AS (
  SELECT "Applicant", app_school_raw, matched_school
  FROM matched
  WHERE rn = 1
),
school_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o."School Name",
    COUNT(bm."Applicant") AS application_count
  FROM "lpf_outreach" o
  LEFT JOIN best_matches bm ON o."School Name" = bm.matched_school
  GROUP BY o."School Name"
),
outreach_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    "School Name",
    SUM("Students Reached") AS total_students_reached
  FROM "lpf_outreach"
  GROUP BY "School Name"
)
SELECT 
  sc."School Name",
  sc.application_count,
  oc.total_students_reached,
  CASE 
    WHEN oc.total_students_reached IS NULL OR oc.total_students_reached = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE sc.application_count * 100.0 / oc.total_students_reached
  END AS applications_per_student_percentage
FROM school_counts sc
JOIN outreach_counts oc ON sc."School Name" = oc."School Name"
ORDER BY sc."School Name";
